ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with localized, extreme high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips and along linear abrasions, resulting in a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous black pigmentation across the majority of both lobes. Discrete, high-contrast white pixel clusters are concentrated at the far-left and far-right distal margins (tips). Scattered high-intensity linear streaks are present across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle; notch depth occupies approximately 15-20% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge. High-amplitude pixel variations are concentrated at the distal tips where biological encrustation (barnacles) creates an uneven, jagged contour; moderate-frequency serration persists along the interior margins toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave upward curvature (positive sweep) from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white) located on the lateral-most tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-intensity (white) linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; specifically, a prominent set of parallel vertical scratches on the far-left lobe and scattered marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral encrustation of barnacles on the outer tips and trailing edges; visible dental rake marks across the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly uniform dark pigmentation across the entire ventral fluke surface, excluding the distal tips and scar tissue.
